'''Devsh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] with his squad around [[3643 BBY]], when they were [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Devsh appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Balmorra. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
